print("=== Verification ===")

    name = row['professorName']
    countries = set(row['countries'].split(", "))
    print(f"\n2. Professor: {name}")
    print(f"   Countries: {countries}")
    
    # Check all countries are valid
    assert countries, "No countries listed"
    
    # Check countries include at least one EU country
    eu_countries = countries & EU
    assert eu_countries, f"No EU country for {name}"

    # Check that countries include ALL countries where they work

    print(f"   All countries present: {countries}")
